task.topic: Extract every source-reported glenoid positioning summary from the supplied primary reports without forcing semantically different measures into a common effect.

pico.population: Human patients or human cadaver shoulders undergoing anatomic or reverse shoulder arthroplasty
pico.exposure: Surgical navigation, patient-specific instruments, or standard instrumentation
pico.comparator: Any reported comparator, or none for a single-arm report
outcomes: Glenoid version, inclination or tilt, and offset or starting-point position

outcome.description: Glenoid version, inclination or tilt, and offset or starting-point position

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: Capture every overall or explicitly labelled subgroup summary with a reported n, mean and SD; retain outcome axis and measurement semantics.

extraction.model_selection_policy: Preserve every source-reported candidate; no study or effect selection occurs in extraction.
extraction.evidence_requirements: Transcribe only source-supported data, preserve exact evidence, and do not calculate, pool, choose an analysis record, or infer missing values.
